name: Logo Design
tagline: A distinctive mark crafted by senior brand designers.
description: Your logo is the handshake of your brand. Our senior designers dig into your audience, competitors and personality, then craft original concepts you can refine with us until it feels unmistakably yours. You receive a complete, production-ready logo suite that works on a business card, a billboard and a phone screen.
includes: Creative brief call with your designer
Vector files (AI, SVG, EPS, PDF) and PNGs

name: Brand Identity Kit
tagline: Logo, colours, type and guidelines — one cohesive system.
description: Go beyond a logo with a complete identity system. We define your colour palette, typography, graphic elements and tone, then package everything in a clear brand guidelines document your team and partners can follow. Ideal for new ventures and rebrands that want to look established from day one.
includes: Primary logo, secondary marks and favicon
Colour palette with print and screen values

name: Social Media Kit
tagline: Scroll-stopping templates you can edit in minutes.
description: A ready-to-post library of on-brand templates for feed posts, stories, covers and carousels. Every template is built in Canva and Figma so your team can drop in new content without breaking the look. Perfect for keeping a consistent feed while posting every day.
includes: Editable feed, story and carousel templates

name: Website & Landing Page Design
tagline: High-converting pages, designed and built for launch.
description: A conversion-focused website designed around your offer. We plan the page structure, write wireframes with you, and deliver a polished responsive design — optionally built in Webflow so you can edit it yourself. Every page is optimised for speed, SEO and accessibility.

name: Animated Logo Intro
tagline: Bring your mark to life for reels, ads and events.
description: A short, polished logo animation for video intros, social content, presentations and event screens. Our motion designers choreograph your mark with sound design that matches your brand's energy — playful, premium or bold.

name: Pitch Deck Design
tagline: Investor-ready slides that tell your story with clarity.
description: We turn your narrative into a crisp, visual deck that investors and clients actually remember. Expect clean data visualisation, custom icons and a master template your team can reuse for every future presentation.
includes: Icon set matched to your brand

name: Email Signature Kit
tagline: Every email, perfectly on brand — for the whole team.
description: Responsive HTML email signatures that render cleanly in Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail. We set up a master design plus a simple generator so every new hire gets a consistent signature in seconds.
includes: Tested in Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail

name: Branded Mugs
tagline: The desk-side reminder of your brand, every single morning.
description: Premium ceramic and enamel mugs printed with dishwasher-safe, fade-resistant inks. Choose a classic, oversized or colour-changing mug and we'll handle artwork setup and send a free digital proof before anything is printed.
includes: Free artwork setup and digital proof
Mix-and-match colours at no extra cost

name: Branded T-Shirts
tagline: Soft, durable tees your team will actually wear.
description: Ring-spun cotton, organic and performance tees decorated with vibrant screen printing or crisp embroidery. Great for staff uniforms, event crews, campaigns and fan merch. Sizes XS to 4XL in 30+ colours.
includes: Free mock-up on your chosen colour

name: Branded Hoodies
tagline: Heavyweight comfort with premium embroidery.
description: Cosy, structured hoodies that feel like retail streetwear, not giveaway merch. Pick midweight or heavyweight fleece and decorate with print or embroidery — the go-to gift for team retreats and community drops.

name: Branded Tote Bags
tagline: Sustainable totes that carry your brand everywhere.
description: Sturdy cotton, organic canvas and jute totes printed in one to full colour. A conference favourite and a retail packaging upgrade — reusable, eco-friendly and seen all over town.

name: Branded Water Bottles
tagline: Insulated bottles with laser-sharp branding.
description: Double-walled stainless steel and borosilicate glass bottles that keep drinks cold for 24 hours. Laser engraving gives a permanent, premium finish; full-colour print lets your artwork pop.

name: Branded Notebooks
tagline: Debossed, foil-stamped notebooks for big ideas.
description: Lay-flat notebooks with soft-touch or vegan leather covers, finished with debossing or foil stamping. Includes ribbon marker, elastic closure and 160 pages of premium paper — a gift people genuinely use.
includes: Back pocket for cards and notes

name: Corporate Gift Box
tagline: Curated, branded gift boxes delivered to every desk.
description: Thoughtfully curated boxes of branded goodies, packed in a custom printed box with a personal note. We source, brand, pack and ship to individual addresses or a single office — perfect for onboarding, client thank-yous and festive seasons.

name: Branded Pens
tagline: Small, smart and endlessly handed around.
description: Smooth-writing pens in plastic, bamboo or metal, printed or engraved with your logo. The most cost-effective way to keep your brand in hands at events, clinics, schools and front desks.

name: Brand Copywriting
tagline: Words that sound like you — and sell like crazy.
description: From a tagline and About page to complete website copy and messaging frameworks, our copywriters capture your voice and translate it into words that build trust and drive action. Every project starts with a voice workshop.

name: Brand Naming
tagline: A memorable name with an available domain.
description: Our naming strategists explore descriptive, evocative and invented directions, screen for domain and social-handle availability, and present a shortlist with rationale. Optional trademark pre-screening gives you extra confidence.

name: Custom Brand Illustration
tagline: Ownable illustrations in a style made just for you.
description: Bespoke illustrations for websites, packaging, social and campaigns. We develop a consistent illustration style that becomes a recognisable part of your brand, in flat, line or 3D-rendered looks.

name: Packaging & Label Design
tagline: Shelf-stopping packaging that flies off the shelf.
description: Print-ready labels, boxes and pouches designed to stand out on crowded shelves and look great in unboxing videos. We handle dielines, regulatory panels and supplier-ready artwork.

name: Mascot & Character Design
tagline: A lovable character that becomes the face of your brand.
description: We design an expressive mascot with a personality sheet, poses and expressions — ready for social, packaging, apps and merch. Characters are one of the fastest ways to make a brand memorable.

name: Infographic & Report Design
tagline: Turn dense data into visuals people share.
description: Clear, beautiful infographics and annual reports that make complex information easy to digest. Ideal for impact reports, investor updates, research and social carousels.

name: Product Photography
tagline: Crisp, consistent product shots for every channel.
description: Studio-lit packshots, flat lays and styled lifestyle scenes captured by professional photographers. Send us your products and receive retouched, marketplace-ready images optimised for your website, Amazon, Jumia, Etsy and social.

name: Brand Story Video
tagline: A cinematic film that shows who you are.
description: From script to screen, we produce a short brand film with professional crew, lighting, sound and colour grading. Perfect for your homepage, launch campaign, investor pitch or recruitment.

name: Team Headshots
tagline: Consistent, flattering headshots for the whole team.
description: Professional headshots in our studio or on-site at your office, with consistent lighting and backgrounds so your team page looks cohesive. Includes light retouching and fast 48-hour delivery.

name: Event Photography
tagline: Every handshake, keynote and candid moment, captured.
description: Experienced event photographers for launches, conferences, weddings-meets-business owambes and award nights. Get a same-day highlights selection for social plus a full edited gallery within 48 hours.

name: Reels & TikTok Content Pack
tagline: Short-form videos made to stop the scroll.
description: A monthly pack of vertical videos scripted, filmed and edited for Reels, TikTok and Shorts. We plan hooks and trends with you, then deliver captioned, ready-to-post videos.

name: Brand Voiceover
tagline: Professional voice talent for ads, IVR and explainers.
description: Choose from a roster of professional voice artists across accents including Nigerian, American, British and Canadian English and French. Recorded in broadcast-quality studios with fast turnaround.

name: Business Cards
tagline: First impressions on thick, luxurious stock.
description: Premium business cards on heavyweight stocks with optional spot UV and foil finishes. Upload your design or let our team set it up for free. Every order includes a digital proof and colour check.

name: Flyers & Leaflets
tagline: Vivid flyers that get picked up — and read.
description: Full-colour flyers and leaflets on silk or gloss paper, perfect for promotions, menus, church and community events, and door drops. Free design check included.

name: Large Format Posters
tagline: Gallery-grade posters, from A2 to A0.
description: Rich, saturated posters printed on satin photo paper with archival inks. Ideal for shopfronts, offices, events and campaigns. Optional lamination for outdoor use.

name: Roll-Up Banner
tagline: Portable, pop-up presence in under 60 seconds.
description: Retractable banners with a sturdy aluminium base and carry bag. Sharp, anti-curl print that stays flat event after event. A must-have for exhibitions, receptions, church programmes and pop-ups.

name: Event Backdrop (Step & Repeat)
tagline: The photo wall every guest wants to pose in front of.
description: Large-format step-and-repeat and branded backdrops for launches, conferences, weddings and press events. Wrinkle-free tension fabric or durable vinyl, with frames that assemble in minutes — no tools needed.
includes: Free layout and logo repeat setup

name: Custom Stickers
tagline: Die-cut stickers for laptops, packaging and fans.
description: Durable, waterproof vinyl stickers in any shape. Glossy, matte or holographic finishes that survive dishwashers, rain and laptop bags. Great for packaging seals, swag and community drops.

name: Letterhead & Stationery Set
tagline: Polished paperwork that looks as good as you work.
description: Letterheads, envelopes and compliment slips printed on premium uncoated paper, plus editable Word and Google Docs templates so your digital documents match your print.
includes: Editable Word and Google Docs templates

name: Trade Show Booth Kit
tagline: A complete branded booth, shipped ready to stand out.
description: Back wall, counter, banners and lighting — designed, printed and packed in wheeled cases. We design the full booth around your brand and the floor plan, so you arrive and set up in under an hour.
includes: Booth design to your floor plan
Fabric back wall and counter wrap
